title: Northbeam TechWorks Business Desk Credit: The Amount a Contract Relief Comes To
content:
A business profile whose contract carries included visits is relieved of what those visits should have covered on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job, together with the attendance charges its contract does not leave with it.

## 1. The visits taken as creditable

The visits taken as creditable are the visits standing in the pool of the visit term less the planned visits the service carries each year. The visits standing in the pool are the visits credited over the visit term less the visits used over it, never below nothing.

## 2. The share of the chargeable labour

The share of the chargeable labour those visits relieve is the proportion the visits standing in the pool bear to the visits the service includes in its visit term, counted as at least one visit. That share is applied to the chargeable labour billed on the day the relief is granted and the outcome rounded to the nearest cent.

## 3. The attendance charges added

To it are added the attendance charges the contract does not leave with the business.

- Nothing of the charge for bringing the crew out is added.
- Nothing of the charge for the distance travelled is added.
- Nothing of the fee for moving the slot is added.

## 4. What the plan has met of the same work

What the plan has met of the same work is then taken off, so that no charge is relieved twice on different grounds: what has been written off to the plan's cover on the job is taken off.

## 5. The limit the relief stands within

The relief is rounded to the nearest cent, is never below nothing, and never exceeds the charges standing unsettled on the job, which are every charge booked on it less every payment received and every amount already written off.

Read as a limit: the charges standing unsettled are a ceiling. Where the amount arrived at above is below that ceiling, the relief is that amount; where it is above it, the relief is the ceiling.

## Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

A hypothetical job under TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual, which includes 12 visits in a visit term of 12 months and carries 4 planned maintenance visits each year. Over the visit term 6 visits have been credited to the job and 2 used, so 4 stand in the pool; the visits taken as creditable are 4 less 4, which is nothing. Chargeable labour of 318.00 USD stands billed on the day the relief is granted. The job carries 900.00 USD of charges in all, 200.00 USD of payments received and 73.20 USD written off to the plan's cover.

| Step | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| Visits standing in the pool | 4 |
| Visits the service includes in its visit term | 12 |
| The share, the proportion the first bears to the second | one third |
| Chargeable labour billed on the day the relief is granted | 318.00 |
| The share applied to it, rounded to the cent | 106.00 |
| The charge for bringing the crew out, added | 0.00 |
| The charge for the distance travelled, added | 0.00 |
| The fee for moving the slot, added | 0.00 |
| What the plan has met of the same work, taken off | 73.20 |
| The charges standing unsettled, as the ceiling | 626.80 |

The relief is 106.00 less 73.20, which is 32.80 USD; it stands above nothing and below the ceiling of 626.80, so the amount credited is **32.80 USD**.
